actions.description: Makes a guest link to an agent chat (--target tab:<id>, --surface N, else the chat that runs the command, else the focused chat): the guest sees the chat as you do, including command output and the agent's reasoning, and each message they send waits for you. --ttl (seconds, or 30m, 24h, 7d; default 24h) and --uses (1 to 8; default 1). --role (view or talk) gives the link a role; a guest who opens it without signing in only watches either way. --signed-in-role (talk, the default, or view) says whether a guest signed in to cmux may also send. `cmux share chat --view-only` sends both as view: a link where nobody sends. Returns share_id, url (null when no share service is configured), expires_at (ms), uses_left, session and surface. Errors: share.needs_sign_in, share.room_unreachable (try again), share.room_refused, share.not_a_chat, share.limit.
actions.title: Share Chat with Guest…

actions.description: Lists this Mac's guest links (all, or one chat's with --target tab:<id> or --surface N): shares, each with share_id, state (provisioning, active, revoked, expired, closed), session, surface, expires_at, expires_in_secs, uses_left, room, guests [{guest_id, name, joined_at, state, account?, role?}] and invitees [{account, role (view, talk), invited_at, state (invited, removed)}]. Never a link's secret.
actions.title: List Guest Links

actions.description: Ends a guest link (--share-id from `cmux share list`): it stops working and every guest on it leaves at once. Returns share_id and state.
actions.title: Revoke Guest Link

actions.description: Removes one guest (--share-id and --guest-id from `cmux share list`) from a guest link: their page ends and they cannot join again. Returns share_id, guest_id and state.
actions.title: Remove Guest

actions.description: Invites a cmux account (--account, an email or @handle; a person's own run without one opens the chat's Invite People sheet) to an agent chat (--target tab:<id>, --surface N, else the chat that runs the command, else the focused chat): once they sign in they see the chat as you do. --role talk (default: they may also send messages, each held for you) or view (watch only). Invites go on the chat's invite share, made first when the chat has none (--ttl, default 7d). Returns share_id, account, role, state and created_share. Errors: share.declined, share.invited (already invited with the other role: uninvite first), share.needs_sign_in, share.limit, share.not_a_chat, share.bad_request (not an email or @handle).
actions.title: Invite People to Chat…

actions.description: Removes an invited cmux account (--account) from an agent chat's shares (--surface N or --target tab:<id>, else the chat that runs the command, else the focused chat; or one share with --share-id): it can no longer join, and every device it joined from leaves at once. Returns account, state and share_ids. Errors: share.not_invited.
actions.title: Remove Invited Person

actions.description: Opens a Cloud workspace on a new small machine of its own, never a listed one (another workspace's, a teammate's or a fleet one). Returns machine_id, title, status and target once the server has it (workspace_id once open); after 30 s, pending: true while the create goes on. A refused create fails with its reason. --target machine:<id> opens on that machine: a connected one returns workspace_id, another connects (a paused one resumes) and answers pending. In the app, the person's own gesture opens on the machine their window shows.
actions.title: New Cloud Workspace

actions.description: Creates a Cloud machine; returns machine_id, title, status and target once the server has it. After 30 s it answers pending: true and the create goes on: check `cmux cloud list-machines` before another. Options: --size small|medium|large|xlarge, --name, --persistent (no idle pause), --bootstrap-script FILE (--bootstrap lane for a lane host), --machine-config FILE (a .cmux/machine.toml), --environment ID|NAME (boot in that Cloud environment), answering bootstrap, machine_config and enrollment. An agent's create may ask the person first.
actions.title: New Cloud Machine…

actions.description: Forks the machine (--target machine:<id>) into a new machine. Answers at once with no id; the new machine shows in `cmux cloud list-machines` when the fork is done.
actions.title: Fork Cloud Machine

actions.description: Takes a snapshot of the machine (--target machine:<id>) and returns machine_id and snapshot_id. A snapshot that takes longer than 30 s answers pending: true and finishes on its own.
actions.title: Snapshot Cloud Machine

actions.description: Starts a new machine from a snapshot: --snapshot <snapshot id>, from `cmux cloud snapshot-machine --target machine:<id>`. With no Cloud workspace focused, also pass --target machine:<id> of any machine; the new machine does not depend on it. Answers at once with no id; the machine shows in `cmux cloud list-machines` when it is up.
actions.title: Restore Cloud Machine…

actions.description: Saves the machine (--target machine:<id>) as a template: a snapshot named template-<first 12 characters of the machine id>-<Unix seconds>, which `cmux cloud restore-machine --target machine:<id> --snapshot <snapshot id>` starts new machines from. Returns machine_id and snapshot_id; after 30 s it answers pending: true and finishes on its own.
actions.title: Promote Machine to Template

actions.description: Reads the machine's state and use (--target machine:<id>) and returns machine_id, title, state, status, CPU, memory and disk use, its address, and its hourly rate and estimated cost when the server reports them.
actions.title: Cloud Machine Status

actions.description: Lists the TCP ports listening on the machine (--target machine:<id>) and returns machine_id and ports (comma-separated). New Cloud also returns private previews, listening and unavailable ports; its menu opens a detected port in the app browser. On the classic link, connect first with `cmux cloud resume-machine --target machine:<id>`.
actions.title: Cloud Machine Ports

actions.description: Shows the machine's login shell, where zsh, git, gh, htop, btop, node, bun and python3 are installed, and the zsh and gh versions. Not a CLI verb: `cmux cloud exec --target machine:<id> --command '...'` runs such checks.
actions.title: Cloud Machine Tools

actions.description: Returns text for handing the machine (--target machine:<id>) to another person or agent (its name, id, provider and live status), with machine_id and status.
actions.title: Hand Off Cloud Machine

actions.description: Moves a chat tab of this Mac to a Cloud machine: copies the chat's folder (--path, else the chat's own) to the machine (--machine machine:<id>, else a connected one, else any, else a new one), moves the chat there and opens it, keeping its session and history. An agent can ask only for its own chat, and its run ignores --path and --machine: it shows the person a card in that chat (Move, Not now, Always) and moves only when they click Move or Always, except that a chat in a folder the person already answered Always for moves at once.
actions.title: Move to Cloud

actions.description: Brings a chat that a move from this Mac put on a Cloud machine back to this Mac: pulls its folder, moves the chat back, opens it here and closes the machine's tab. Only a person runs it: an agent's run (MCP, or the CLI from an agent's chat) is refused.
actions.title: Bring Back Local

actions.description: Moves a chat that a move from this Mac put on a Cloud machine to another Cloud machine (--machine machine:<id>, else a connected one, else any, else a new one): its folder goes machine to machine and never into this Mac's folder (as git when it can: the new machine clones from GitHub and gets only the folder's own changes), the chat moves there with the old machine's last changes, opens there, and the old machine's tab closes. Only a person runs it: an agent's run (MCP, or the CLI from an agent's chat) is refused.
actions.title: Move to Another Machine

actions.description: Opens a new terminal tab in the machine's first workspace (--target machine:<id>), resuming a paused machine first, and returns machine_id, workspace_id and the tab's surface_id (terminal_id when known). The window shows it only with --focus. When the run takes longer than 30 s it answers machine_id and pending: true, and the tab still opens.
actions.title: Open Cloud SSH Terminal

actions.description: Runs a shell command on the machine through the Cloud API and returns machine_id, exit_code, stdout and stderr; no tab opens. Needs --target machine:<id> and --command; the command stops after 25 s. A person's run from the palette types it into a new terminal tab instead.
actions.title: Run Command on Cloud Machine…

actions.description: Copies this Mac's git user.name and user.email to the machine (--target machine:<id>) and sets up GitHub: through the cmux GitHub App when the team has connected it (git gets a short-lived token per repo; no token stored), else a GitHub CLI sign-in there. No token leaves this Mac. Returns ok, method (app or device), fallback_reason, gh_status (app, logged_in, pending, missing or failed), the identity it set and, while a sign-in waits, device_code and verification_uri; --focus opens that page.
actions.title: Set Up GitHub on This Machine

actions.description: Lists a directory on the machine (--target machine:<id> --path /absolute/dir) and returns path, count and text with one line per entry (d for a directory, - for a file, with its size).
actions.title: List Cloud Files…

actions.description: Reads a file on the machine (--target machine:<id> --path /absolute/file) and returns path, encoding and the contents in text: UTF-8 as is, anything else as base64 (also in data_base64), with size when known.
actions.title: Read Cloud File…

actions.description: Writes --contents as UTF-8 text to a file on the machine (--target machine:<id> --path /absolute/file), replacing it in one step. Returns no fields.
actions.title: Write Cloud File…

actions.description: Creates a directory on the machine (--target machine:<id> --path /absolute/dir). Returns no fields.
actions.title: Create Cloud Directory…

actions.description: Removes a file on the machine (--target machine:<id> --path /absolute/file). Destructive: a CLI or agent run needs --confirm. Returns no fields.
actions.title: Remove Cloud File…

actions.description: Reads a file's details on the machine (--target machine:<id> --path /absolute/path) and returns path, kind, and size and mode (octal) when known.
actions.title: Cloud File Details…

actions.description: Authorizes an SSH public key (--public-key, the key's text) for file transfer to the machine (--target machine:<id>) and returns host, port, user, host_key and expires_at (Unix seconds) for scp or sftp.
actions.title: Prepare Cloud File Transfer…

actions.description: Attaches this Mac's Cloud tunnel to its team's network, the only one it joins. The path argument is optional: none means the joined team; a network id (--arg path=<team id>) must be that team's. Returns no fields.
actions.title: Attach Cloud Tunnel Network

actions.description: Detaches this Mac's Cloud tunnel from its team's network. The path argument is optional: none means the joined team; a network id (--arg path=<team id>) must be that team's. Returns no fields.
actions.title: Detach Cloud Tunnel Network

actions.description: Gives this Mac a new WireGuard key for its Cloud tunnel: the agent daemon makes the key, registers it, then uses it. Returns no fields.
actions.title: Rotate Cloud Tunnel Key

actions.description: Lists the account's Cloud networks and returns count and text with one line per network: its id, scope and CIDR.
actions.title: List Cloud Networks

actions.description: Lists the account's Cloud firewall rules and returns count and text with one line per rule: its id and description (else its action).
actions.title: List Cloud Firewall Rules

actions.description: Reads one Cloud firewall rule and returns id, action and text. The rule id goes in the path argument: --arg path=<rule id>.
actions.title: Get Cloud Firewall Rule

actions.description: Creates a Cloud firewall rule from JSON in the path argument: --arg 'path={"source":{...},"destination":{...},"description":"..."}'. Returns no fields.
actions.title: Create Cloud Firewall Rule

actions.description: Deletes a Cloud firewall rule (--arg path=<rule id>). Destructive: a CLI or agent run needs --confirm. Returns no fields.
actions.title: Delete Cloud Firewall Rule

actions.description: Lists the account's Cloud domains and returns count and text with one line per domain: its hostname and its verification and certificate states.
actions.title: List Cloud Domains

actions.description: Lists the account's Cloud publications and returns count and text with one line per publication: its hostname, state and access mode.
actions.title: List Cloud Publications

actions.description: Provisions an API on the machine (--target machine:<id>): publishes --port behind cmux sign-in under a generated https hostname and mints an API key for it, in one call. Returns url, publication_id, api_key_id, key and cookie. API clients send the key as the cookie (__Host-cmux-api-key=<key>), which the machine never receives; the key is answered this one time. Running it again for the same port reuses the URL and mints another key. Optional --name names the key.
actions.title: Provision API on Machine…

actions.description: Lists the live API keys of a Cloud publication (--arg path=<publication id or hostname>) and returns count and text with one line per key: its id, name and last four characters.
actions.title: List Cloud API Keys

actions.description: Revokes an API key (--arg path=<publication id or hostname> --arg key=<key id>); requests with it are refused from the next one on. Destructive: a CLI or agent run needs --confirm. Returns api_key_id and revoked_at.
actions.title: Revoke Cloud API Key

actions.description: Returns the app's Cloud machines: loaded, count, account.signed_in and machines, each with machine_id, target (machine:<id>), title, status, owner, created_by, created_at and error. created_by is the creator's user ID, or null when unavailable. error is the platform's {code, message} for the machine's last failed change (why it failed), or null when there is none. loaded false means the list is not known yet (signed out, or still loading after 25 s with pending: true), not that there are none.
actions.title: List Cloud Machines

actions.description: Opens a new workspace with a terminal on the machine (--target machine:<id>), resuming a paused machine first, and returns machine_id, workspace_id and, when known, the terminal's surface_id. With --workspace <id> (a workspace_id it returned) it adds a terminal tab to that workspace of the machine instead and returns its surface_id; an id the machine does not have is refused. The window shows it only with --focus. When the whole run takes longer than 30 s it answers machine_id and pending: true, and the terminal still opens.
actions.title: New Terminal Workspace on Machine

actions.description: Shows the machine's first workspace in the window (creating one when it has none), connecting it and resuming it when paused. Not a CLI verb: `cmux cloud new-terminal-on-machine --target machine:<id> --focus` opens and shows a workspace.
actions.title: Open Machine

actions.description: Shows the machine's desktop (--target machine:<id>) in a new workspace on this Mac: the agent's display as a live video stream over the machine's carrier (--viewer rd, the only viewer), opened watching (Take over in the pane gives you the mouse and keyboard, Hand back returns them). Only the machine's creator can open it, on a cmux NEXT machine that serves a desktop; anything else is refused at once, as is a classic machine. Answers at once with no fields, before the desktop shows.
actions.title: Open Desktop

actions.description: Renames the machine (--target machine:<id> --name <name>; an empty name clears it). Answers at once, before the rename is done. Without --name it asks the person for the name in the app, so a script or agent passes --name.
actions.title: Rename Machine…

actions.description: Deletes the machine (--target machine:<id>) and everything on it. Destructive: a CLI or agent run needs --confirm. Answers at once, before the delete is done.
actions.title: Kill Machine

actions.description: Pauses the machine (--target machine:<id>); the run ends when the server has paused it. Returns no fields. `cmux cloud resume-machine --target machine:<id>` starts it again.
actions.title: Pause Machine

actions.description: Resumes a paused machine (--target machine:<id>); the run ends when the server has resumed it. Returns no fields.
actions.title: Resume Machine

actions.description: Makes the platform's expiring share link for a port of the machine (--port) and copies it to the clipboard. Not a CLI verb.
actions.title: Copy Machine Link

actions.description: Copies http://<machine address>:<port> (--port) to the clipboard. Not a CLI verb.
actions.title: Copy Machine Port

actions.description: Copies the machine's id to the clipboard. Not a CLI verb: `cmux cloud list-machines` returns ids.
actions.title: Copy Machine ID

actions.description: Resizes the machine (--target machine:<id>): --size small, medium, large or xlarge (2 vCPU and 4 GB, 4 and 8, 8 and 16, or 16 and 24), --disk GIB (the disk's new size in whole GiB: 4 GiB steps, up to 256, grow-only), or both in one call; at least one. Returns machine_id, target, and size and disk_gib as given. Answers pending after 30 s; the resize goes on.
actions.title: Resize Machine…

actions.description: Applies a .cmux/machine.toml (env, secret names, setup) to the machine (--target machine:<id>): --machine-config FILE uploads one, else the machine takes its --repo checkout's or the last upload. Answers status (started, running or failed) at once; the machine writes the outcome to ~/.cmux/machine-config/status.json, read with `cmux cloud file-read --target machine:<id> --path …`.
actions.title: Apply Machine Config

actions.description: Sends the values of the secret names the machine's .cmux/machine.toml declares (--target machine:<id>, --repo OWNER/NAME for repo-scoped ones) from this Mac's Keychain to the machine over its daemon link, never the Cloud API. An own machine (an SSH machine or an acpmux peer, --target machine:<name>) gets exactly --names A,B over ssh, in ~/.config/cmux/machine-secrets.env; its shells read them through the returned source_line. Returns status (delivered, unchanged or pending), delivered and missing names. Values are stored with cmux cloud secret set NAME.
actions.title: Deliver Secrets to Machine

actions.description: Sets how long the machine (--target machine:<id>) may sit idle (nothing attached, running or forwarded) before cmux Cloud pauses it: --minutes off, 15, 30, 60 or 120. Returns machine_id and idle_pause_minutes (0 for off).
actions.title: Pause When Idle…

enumeration.title: GitHub, Package Registries and Model Providers

actions.description: Sets what the machine (--target machine:<id>) may reach on the internet: --access full (every public address), trusted (only GitHub, the package registries and the model providers the server lists as presets) or none (only the hosts cmux itself needs). Applies live, with no restart, and keeps the machine's own allowed ranges and domains. An agent may only choose none (turn access off). Returns machine_id, network_access, mode and applied (applied, pending or failed).
actions.title: Internet Access…

actions.description: Deletes a snapshot of the machine (--target machine:<id> --snapshot <snapshot id>). Destructive: a CLI or agent run needs --confirm. Returns no fields.
actions.title: Delete Cloud Snapshot…

actions.description: Checks the Cloud sign-in, the backend and each machine's link, and returns summary (the first thing that needs attention, else that all is well) and details (a JSON report with no secrets).
actions.title: Cloud Diagnostics

actions.description: Switches the active team (--team, its id or name) that Cloud machines are listed and created under. Not a CLI verb.
actions.title: Switch Active Team…

actions.description: Opens the cmux sign-in page, which Cloud needs. Answers at once, before the person signs in; refused when already signed in. Not offered to MCP: a person signs in.
actions.title: Sign In

actions.description: Signs this Mac out of cmux and Cloud. Answers at once. Not offered to MCP.
actions.title: Sign Out

actions.description: Opens the Mobile Pairing page in the active window, which walks the person through pairing an iPhone and shows a QR code. It takes focus only with --focus; refused when no window is open.
actions.title: Open Mobile Pairing

actions.description: Opens --port N (and --path, default /) of the machine (--target machine:<id>) in a Chromium tab and returns url and surface_id. New Cloud uses its private preview URL. On the classic Cloud link the tab opens in the machine's workspace (workspace_id) and its localhost is the machine's.
actions.title: Open Machine Port in Browser…

actions.description: Lists the machine's (--target machine:<id>) ports forwarded to this Mac: forwards, each with port, local_port, url and state. Only machines on the Cloud app server link keep forwards; on the classic link use `cmux cloud open-browser --target machine:<id> --port <port>`.
actions.title: List Forwarded Machine Ports

actions.description: Forwards --port N of the machine (--target machine:<id>) to a port on this Mac and returns local_port, url (http://127.0.0.1:<local_port>/) and state. Close it with `cmux cloud port-close --target machine:<id> --port <port>`. Cloud app server link only.
actions.title: Forward Machine Port…

actions.description: Stops forwarding --port N of the machine (--target machine:<id>) to this Mac and returns closed: true; a port with no forward is refused. `cmux cloud port-list --target machine:<id>` lists the forwards.
actions.title: Close Forwarded Machine Port…

actions.description: Creates a one-day anonymous link for --port N of the machine (--target machine:<id>), copies it to the clipboard and returns the URL and linkId. Revoke it with `cmux cloud preview-revoke --target machine:<id> --port <port> --link-id <id>`. Cloud app server link only.
actions.title: Share Machine Preview…

actions.description: Revokes --link-id for --port N of the machine (--target machine:<id>) and returns revoked: true. Cloud app server link only.
actions.title: Revoke Machine Preview Link…

actions.description: Returns the machine's (--target machine:<id>) link instead of copying it: machine_id, target and its private address. With --port N, also private_url and the platform's expiring share link for that port: url, linkId and expiresAt. Revoke it with `cmux cloud preview-revoke --target machine:<id> --port <port> --link-id <id>`.
actions.title: Get Machine Link…

arguments.name: fromFolder
arguments.title: Folder on This Mac to Copy

actions.description: Starts an agent session (--agent claude, codex, ...) in the Cloud machine's own acpmux and returns machine_id, session_id and host, plus the chat tab's workspace_id and surface_id. Name the machine with --target machine:<id>, or --name <name> to take or create it; --cwd is the folder there, or --from-folder copies one from this Mac. --login pass|machine|none: your login, the machine's own, or none (default: the machine's login or your earlier choice). An agent's run asks no one (unless cloud.agentsStartWithoutAsking is off). A slow run answers pending: true; run it again for its session.
actions.title: Start Agent Session on Cloud Machine…
